According to Malaysian Employment Act, employees shall be entitled to the progressive paid leave depending on their year of service. Number of minimal PTO should be 16 days because eight days per year for employees who have worked one to two years, 12 days per year for those who have worked two to five years, 16 days per year for employees who have worked longer than five years.

Do not include statutory, bank holidays, or public holidays in the number you enter. They are excluded and are based on the employee's country of residence.
